learning.title: Point Playwright at the host browser cache when a seat's HOME is sandboxed
learning.trigger: A web Playwright run fails in one or two milliseconds per test with browserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist at /home/marktripoli/.openrig/state/omp/<seat>/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-<rev>/chrome-headless-shell-linux64/chrome-headless-shell.
learning.rule: The omp seat sandbox rewrites HOME, so Playwright resolves browsers under the seat's state directory while the installed browsers live in /home/marktripoli/.cache/ms-playwright. Export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/home/marktripoli/.cache/ms-playwright for every pnpm exec playwright test. Fixture-backed specs also need something answering /v1/installation/status through Vite's proxy, because tests/helpers/stack-preflight.ts fetches it before any spec runs; when the specs mock /v1 in the browser, a stub returning 200 on BAKERY_SERVER_PORT satisfies it without a stack. Run with BAKERY_WEB_PREVIEW=1 and an owned BAKERY_WEB_PORT, and drive a clean copy of the PR head: a dev worktree can carry unstaged edits that differ from the SHA under review.

verification.requirement: Runnable evidence: the same command finds the browser, stack-preflight passes, and the named spec reports its pass/skip counts with exit 0. A build whose HEAD differs from the reviewed SHA is not usable evidence.
